label: A NECESSARY_2 concretum supported anywhere is supported by an actual concretum
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: for every admitted world v and concrete candidates a and b, if b exists at every world accessible from w, a exists at v and a stands to b in the selected relation at v, then some concrete candidate existing at w stands to b in the selected relation at w. The supporter at w may differ from the one at v and need not be necessary; no support edge need persist between worlds.
